v.3: No indeed, soon you will know!
v.4: No indeed, soon you will know for yet another time!
v.5: Indeed, were you to know with certain knowledge,
v.6: you would have surely seen hell [in this very life].
v.7: Afterward you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
v.8: Then, on that day, you will surely be questioned concerning the Blessing.
